description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular rash on both knees.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the anterior aspect of both knees. The skin exhibits a diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash, with small, scattered red lesions. The rash appears symmetrical and is more prominent on the lateral aspects of the knees. The surrounding skin shows no evidence of excoriation, ulceration, or significant swelling.

description.short_caption: Diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash on the abdomen.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the abdomen of a patient with a diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash. The rash consists of small, red macules and papules distributed across the skin. The umbilicus is visible, and the rash appears to be non-confluent with no evident vesicles or pustules. The skin texture appears otherwise normal, and there are no signs of excoriation or ulceration.

description.short_caption: Microscopic examination of a stool specimen showing helminth larvae.
description.detailed_description: This is a microscopic image of a stool specimen stained to highlight parasitic structures. Several elongated, thread-like structures consistent with helminth larvae are visible against a yellowish-brown background. The larvae have a curved or coiled appearance, with some showing tapering ends. The staining technique enhances the contrast between the larvae and the surrounding debris.

description.short_caption: Microscopic examination of a sputum specimen showing a helminth larva.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a microscopic view of a sputum specimen stained to highlight structures. A prominent, curved helminth larva is visible in the center, surrounded by smaller particles and debris. The larva appears elongated with a smooth body surface, consistent with a parasitic organism. The background contains scattered particulate matter, likely mucus and cellular debris.
